definition: Able to recover or adapt after difficulty or strain.
example: The resilient team learned from the failed launch and tried a revised approach.
nuance: Resilience means recovering or adapting; it does not require being untouched by harm.
prompt: A community rebuilds and adapts after a damaging setback.
options: The resilient community rebuilt its services after the storm.
The resilient community never encountered any challenge, so its capacity to recover was demonstrated.
The resilient plan resisted every change even when conditions demanded adaptation.
reasons: This sentence demonstrates the meaning: able to recover or adapt after difficulty or strain.
Without a challenge, this sentence does not demonstrate recovery capacity.
Rigid resistance to necessary adaptation is not resilience.
